mode.title: Scrape Mode
mode.description: Select whether to run a daily delta update, full scrape, or NOC sync.
enumTitles: Daily Delta Update (New Postings + NOC Sync + Sheets Sync)
Full Scrape (All Active Canadian LMIA Jobs)

max_jobs.title: Max Jobs Limit (0 for all)
max_jobs.description: Maximum number of new jobs to scrape. Set to 0 to scrape all available.

database_url.title: Neon PostgreSQL Connection String (Optional)
database_url.description: Direct Neon PostgreSQL URL for auto-ingestion into the CRM. e.g. postgresql://user:pwd@ep-sample.neon.tech/neondb?sslmode=require

google_sheet_id.title: Google Sheet ID (Optional)
google_sheet_id.description: The spreadsheet ID from your Google Sheet URL (docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/<ID>/edit).

google_sheet_tab_name.title: Google Sheet Tab Name
google_sheet_tab_name.description: Tab name to update with today's newly scraped data (overwrites yesterday's data on each run).

google_service_account_json.title: Google Service Account JSON (Optional)
google_service_account_json.description: Paste the Google Cloud Service Account JSON credentials to write directly to Google Sheets.

google_sheet_webhook_url.title: Google Apps Script Webhook URL (Optional)
google_sheet_webhook_url.description: Alternative to Service Account: Paste your Google Apps Script Webhook URL.

enable_hermes_ai.title: Enable Hermes AI Enrichment
enable_hermes_ai.description: Use Hermes AI agent to research missing employer websites and emails.

openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter API Key (Optional)
openrouter_api_key.description: API key for OpenRouter AI enrichment if enabled.
